name: watermark
description: The RP's per-subject revocation watermark (#135): every verified session-revoked SET advances it, for unknown subjects too, durably before the 202; session creation is refused when login_iat <= the watermark. Steps run in order against one empty store keyed by (iss, sub).

watermark.note: no watermark yet: any login is allowed
a session-revoked SET for a subject the RP has never linked (unknown sub): answered 202, and the watermark is still recorded
an ID token minted before the revocation but redeemed after it cannot create a session
a login after the revocation is allowed
a stale (redriven, reordered) SET never lowers the watermark
still refused after the stale SET
another issuer's subject is a different key: its clock does not order against this one
a newer cause raises the watermark
the login that was allowed before is now refused
